phase: 7 -- official brand inventory audit (identity and routing only)
lane: direct_http against published first-party sitemaps; no vendor, no browser, no credit
cost_note: every one of those is a free first-party GET of a document the brand publishes for crawlers. No vendor, no browser, no plan credit, no USD.
timing_note: the first sweep took 96 minutes, almost all of it Hilton's 539 property shards at roughly ten seconds each. Every later invocation reads the cache and takes seconds, which is why the two timings are reported separately rather than one overwriting the other.
what_this_lane_can_decide: identity: the brand names its own property, its code and its city
routing: the brand's own inventory is what makes a route live or dead
what_this_lane_can_never_decide: pet policy -- a sitemap carries a URL and a timestamp and nothing else
